description: Shear Wall Database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). This shear wall database contains material and geometric properties, experimental results, and references for tests of reinforced concrete structural walls subjected to lateral-load reversals. Data files containing load-deflection data are currently being processed and will be offered here soon. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 14 top-level files (PDF, CSV). Its DOI is 10.4231/d38c9r416. Keywords: shear wall, databases, earthquake engineering , tongji university , experimental results, reinforced concrete. Published 2013-05-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
